epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Note from the session that files and confirms epic #34659's cards. Written 2026-11-18T05:47Z. This card is now a child of #34659 and stays open.

This session had proposed to fold it into #34789 (the review of over-literal assertions) and close it. That premise failed on reading: #34789 was closed as completed when PR #35022 merged, and `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json:53` on main still reads `"must_not_contain": ["defineDataset"]`. So this case was not part of what landed, and this card is the place it gets fixed.

Two additions to its scope:

- It is #34770's own evidence case, so it is fixed before #34770's before-and-after reading is taken, not after.
- The same shape, a bare identifier in `must_not_contain` that a correct answer may mention, is worth one pass over the other cases while this one is open. Whether #34789's review covered that pass in full was not read here.
